high_level_description: The image depicts a fashion runway scene. The model is walking down the runway, showcasing an outfit that consists of a long, black coat with wide sleeves and a high collar. Underneath the coat, the model wears a white shirt with vertical black stripes, paired with matching striped trousers. A white scarf is tied around the neck, adding a touch of elegance to the ensemble. The model's footwear appears to be simple sandals. The runway is illuminated by focused lighting, creating a dramatic contrast with the darker surroundings.
